repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbUb7TcZK1XUAddUmQ

Ruled · 2026-11-18T15:35Z: a second objectstack seat on this parent. The maintainer, verbatim, in the os-bill project session, 2026-11-18:
- 15:34Z 「你接的是 35159」 (to repo:objectstack#5, seat post #35217).
- 15:34Z 「warren 只处理 35159 在手任务」.

So repo:objectstack#1 (os-warren) keeps the children it holds now: #35005 (with its governed follow-up #35158), #35138, #35144 (draft PR #35193) and #35145. Every other card of this parent, open now or filed later, is repo:objectstack#5's. Seat 1's other work (#35205) is untouched by this ruling.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbUb7TcZK1XUAddUmQ

Ruled · 2026-11-18T15:54Z: the maintainer withdrew this seat's intake of this parent. Verbatim, in the os-bill project session, 2026-11-18T15:52Z: 「35159 你不用处理了，准备接 area:ux」.

So the split recorded in 6983285899 no longer stands: repo:objectstack#5 takes no card of #35159. This seat will take `area:ux` cards after #35205's backfill.
